text: なに　して　いるかって？

structure.jp: なに　して　いるか

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after words shows they are what someone said or asked. って is its casual form, and here the 'you ask' is left out. なに　して　いるかって = 'what am I doing, you ask?'

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. して　いる = 'am doing'.
